sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that he cares for his wife and wants to live a happy marital life.
The complainant, who is represented by her lawyers submits that she also is willing to live with the husband.
5. Learned counsel submits that the petitioner that he will be visiting the in-laws house between 27-28th April, 2024 to bring his wife with full respect and however to his own home.
He further submits that to the best of his ability, the petitioner will try to keep her happy.

6. On the said positive submissions put forward by the learned counsel for the petitioner and endorsed by the informant this Court is inclined to give him interim relief for two months.
7.

Put up this case on 10th of May, 2024 at 4:00 P.M.
8.

In the meantime, let no coercive steps be taken against the petitioner in connection with Complaint Case NO. 1634-C of 2021 pending in the Court of Judicial Magistrate-1st Class,
Begusarai.

(Rajiv Roy, J) Jagdish/-
